I built Loaf, a Tamagotchi-style step pet in Grok Bot.

You tell it your steps. It gets smug or sleepy. Rest days count. No shame.

Free to add if you have Grok Bot: https://t.co/QbF59q7ReD

I use it so walking feels like taking care of something, not another streak to break. https://t.co/8Ed7LGKUJp
